description: Permissions the Orelis webview needs on every platform.

permissions.description: Privileged operations (staff Auth users, custom claims, cascade deletes, AI flows) run on the hosted deployment. Routing those through the Rust HTTP client rather than webview fetch avoids a cross-origin request from tauri://localhost and the CORS preflight it would need — the app origin is not a web origin the server can whitelist meaningfully.
